mentions.name: Hugo static fanfiction site
mentions.description: This static website built with Hugo and served via nginx hosts fanfiction, with experiments like audio embeds. It works around static-site-generator friction by using pandoc for most markdown-to-HTML conversion and goldmark for pages where a table of contents matters.
mentions.problem: AO3 outages prompted self-hosting fanfiction; Hugo resists running pandoc with custom arguments, pandoc won't generate a ToC on the markdown files, and goldmark misprocesses markdown italics inside HTML tags.
mentions.source_excerpt: a static Hugo website (for hosting fanfiction; there've been a few AO3 outages lately and I thought it would be fun to experiment with things like audio embeds)
